guarantees.claim: The register done_state_q is updated to done_state_d on every positive edge of clk_i, unless rst_ni is low, in which case it is set to DoneAwaitCmd.

assumptions.claim: The next-state signal done_state_d must always represent a legal state encoding in the done FSM state space.
assumptions.cond: when rst_ni is high and clock edge occurs
assumptions.risk: If an illegal state value is loaded into done_state_q, the HMAC control logic may behave unpredictably, potentially skipping security-critical steps or causing deadlock.

uncertain_points.claim: The derivation of done_state_d depends on external combinational or sequential logic not present in this chunk; a full FSM verification requires its source.
uncertain_points.risk: Without reviewing that logic, a bug in the next-state logic could cause invalid state transitions or security bypass.
